hooks.text: 枪械、部件、遗物融合、塔罗牌和元素效果都能叠进武器，把多弹幕或单发融血条做成两条极端路线。
hooks.excerpt: Fancy weapons, special Weapon Parts, Relic fusion, Tarot Cards, elemental effects, random events... Every pickup is another experiment in weapon customization. Stack up Projectiles and become a "Fireworks Master", or pour everything into a single shot and melt an entire health bar—your weapons, your rules.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 高难度会解锁混沌战疤，每道战疤同时带来增益和诅咒，逼玩家把风险也纳入终极构筑。
hooks.excerpt: They also unlock the unique [Chaos Battle Scar] mode, where every Battle Scar comes with both a boon and a curse. High risk, high reward. Harness the boons, master the curses, and forge a one-of-a-kind ultimate build that pushes beyond the limits!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 多人局既能极限救援和交换道具，也用DPS榜制造后期反超与“输出王”竞争。
hooks.excerpt: Multiplayer has everything you would expect: clutch saves, item swapping, and fighting through tough encounters together... But the real fun is farming up quietly in the early game, then surging ahead to overtake everyone in damage later! Check the DPS rankings—who is the true damage king of your squad, and who is the poor soul stuck doing all the thankless work as the team's "support bot"?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
